messages:
Jen (AE): FYI — Taylor from VaultCorp wants an accelerated POC but their DC is completely siloed (no outbound egress). Can we run Redwood Private in that environment and what are the blockers?
Mike (SE): Short answer: yes, but packaging + bootstrap are the main lift. Need signed offline bundle, jumpbox instructions, and a deterministic upgrade plan.
Taylor (Customer): Correct — comms to internet are disallowed. We can provide a jump-host that pulls bundles via an approved transfer device.
Bryn (Ops): @Mike can you confirm agent bootstrap flow? We usually recommend a signed tarball + installation script. Example minimal flow: `scp bundle.tar.gz jumpbox:/tmp && ssh jumpbox 'sudo ./install.sh --offline --key /opt/keys/customer-signing.pem'`
Mike (SE): Exactly. We'll produce an immutable bundle with SBOM + signature. Also need to know if they allow KMS calls to our control plane — if not, they must use customer-managed KMS/HSM.
Taylor (Customer): No calls to external KMS allowed. All keys stay in HSM.
Sam (Legal): We'll need to provide a formal attestation and the bundle signing key fingerprint. Also customer will require a answers to parts of the security questionnaire (encryption-at-rest, transport, key rotation cadence).
Avery (Pricing): For an offline POC we typically offer a timeboxed pilot SKU (30/60/90 days) priced as a one-off seat + support. If they want ongoing private deployment, switch to enterprise licensing. Estimates available once we confirm GPU requirements and bundle support.
Jen (AE): Timeline ask from Taylor: POC start in two weeks. Is that realistic? What are showstoppers?
Bryn (Ops): Showstoppers: 1) signing process + verification, 2) how updates are applied (delta vs full bundle), 3) cert rotation without internet, 4) on-site personnel for cutover.
Mike (SE): For upgrades we support delta patching but offline delta requires a patch packaging step on our side to produce a signed delta artifact. Ops will need a script to apply and validate. We can provide `apply-patch.sh` and a verify step returning exit codes.
Mike (SE): Example verify command we send:```bash
./apply-patch.sh --artifact patch-v1.2.3.sig && ./verify.sh --bundle /opt/redwood/current
```
Taylor (Customer): Who runs the verification? Our infra team or Redwood? We prefer ours to run it but want a signed verification package from you.
Bryn (Ops): Customer runs apply+verify. We provide deterministic tools and logs; logs are shipped back via an approved channel (encrypted USB or secure transfer), and we can do remote review after they share.
Sam (Legal): Also add requirement: cryptographic proof of bundle provenance (signed with a Redwood offline key). We'll need the public key and a CV of the process owner.
Avery (Pricing): Pricing note: signed offline bundles and per-release support is an add-on (engineering time + signing gate). Add ~1-2 FTE-days of SRE involvement per patch window in the SOW for the POC.
Jen (AE): Any flag on SLA? For POC we usually do best-effort, but customer asked about an uptime target for the demo (not full SLA).
Bryn (Ops): We'll commit to response SLAs for POC triage only (e.g., 4 business hours), not production uptime. Put that in SOW.
InfraBot: Deploy checklist created: `redwood-offline-poc-checklist.md` — includes bundle signing, SBOM, HSM instructions, patch process, acceptance tests. Link: https://redwood.internal/poc-checklists/1729994321
Mike (SE): Action items: 1) I will draft the offline bundle manifest and sample install scripts (ETA 48h). 2) Ops to outline delta packaging process (Bryn). 3) Legal to prepare attestation template (Sam). 4) Pricing to produce POC quote (Avery).
Sam (Legal): I'll also flag export controls if bundle contains model weights — need to confirm model licensing for offline distribution.
Taylor (Customer): We will confirm GPU/CPU counts and the jumpbox transfer process by EOD. Also can share the security questionnaire now.
Jen (AE): Great — I'll coordinate. If we can get the bundle & scripts ready in 48h and customer confirms transfer method, we can hit the 2-week start.
Bryn (Ops): Note — for cert rotation in offline mode, we support an on-site rotation script that accepts new certs via a signed envelope. We'll include docs.
Mike (SE): One more thing — telemetry. Customer wants no telemetry out. We'll build a zero-telemetry config (disable stats + usage pings). Need signoff.
Taylor (Customer): Yes please, zero telemetry for the POC.
Jen (AE): Thanks team. I'll open the SOW draft and attach the security Q + POC dates. ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
Avery (Pricing): I'll drop a preliminary number by tomorrow morning.
Sam (Legal): Sending attestation template in thread.
Mike (SE): Uploading sample bundle manifest in 1hr.
Bryn (Ops): I'll prepare the patch runbook and a short runthrough doc for the on-site engineer.
Jen (AE): Closing loop — next sync in 48h after initial artifacts delivered.
notes: Ensure last_message_ts is later than first_message_ts and messages are chronological. This thread documents POC coordination for a fully offline data center and covers packaging, upgrade cadence, signing, legal attestation, pricing, and operational runbooks.
